name: l3/sql/removal_query

comparison: set: `rows` compared as a multiset (they are stored sorted by their JSON encoding); SQL text must be byte-identical (`sql_sha256`); values are as scanned by the Go ETL (see `value_encoding`)

rules.nullstring: JSON string, or null for SQL NULL; untrimmed, exactly as returned
rules.string: JSON string (column scanned as non-null text)
